segments.text: If your first instinct after eating dinner is to head straight over to the couch, hold on for 10
minutes. If you never met me, I'm Yolanda. At 64, I lost 28 pounds and have kept it off for over a
year now. All naturally, no shots, no meds, and no calorie count. And I'm not AI. Here's why 10
minutes after your meal, glucose starts flooding your bloodstream. If you sit down, that sugar just
sits there forcing your body to pump out excess insulin. But if you keep your legs moving, just
15 chair squats or calf raises while washing dishes or march in place your muscles will act
like a sponge and soak up that sugar no intense workouts required got it so let me know in the
comments are you gonna try this 10 minute trick after your next meal drop a yes and don't forget
to share this with a friend
